purpose: Audit an independently annotated network-attack corpus for clean pre-attack histories and explicit onset timestamps before training another forecasting model.

dataset_properties_expected_from_publish.traffic: consumer-IoT network attack and benign traces
dataset_properties_expected_from_publish.annotation: attack start timestamp, end timestamp, impacted flow features, attack label

final_validation: locked; no existing Garuda final-validation family is scored by V33
audit_outputs: download SHA256 and byte size for annotation and flow archives
number of parseable timestamped attack annotations
candidate count with at least 8 minutes of observable flow history before attack onset when timestamps can be resolved
decision_rule: Use this corpus for the next clean-onset forecasting experiment only if annotations are timestamp-parseable and sufficient flow history can be matched before multiple attack onsets.
claim_boundary: V33 is a provenance/schema/support audit only and cannot establish forecasting accuracy, recall, FPR, lead time, or zero-day prediction.
